top_choice_rationale: P001 recognizes induced proximity to an E3 ligase as a design rule: a small molecule bridges a chosen protein to a ligase and the cell destroys it. The mechanism is structurally confirmed in ternary complexes, quantitatively characterized (cooperativity, hook effect, kinetics) and reproduced widely, and it reaches targets with no druggable pocket. Crews and Deshaies carry the bifunctional concept and Handa carries cereblon as the glue target. The cost is that Ciulli and others are omitted and no degrader is approved, but a principle-level citation avoids promising a drug. P002 is a mature, cleanly attributed method but a C-N variant of a paradigm honoured in 2010, so it ranks second; an award is preferred to no award.
